section.title: The Uniform Distribution
section.p: The uniform distribution is a continuous probability distribution and is concerned with events that are equally likely to occur. When working out problems that have a uniform distribution, be careful to note if the data is inclusive or exclusive of endpoints.
The mathematical statement of the uniform distribution is
f(x) = $$\frac{1}{b - a}$$ for a ≤ x ≤ b
where a = the lowest value of x and b = the highest value of x.

problem.p: a. What is the probability that a person waits fewer than 12.5 minutes?

solution.p: a. Let X = the number of minutes a person must wait for a bus. a = 0 and b = 15. X ~ U(0, 15). Write the probability density function. f (x) = $$\frac{1}{15\ - \ 0}$$ = $$\frac{1}{15}$$ for 0 ≤ x ≤ 15.
The probability a person waits less than 12.5 minutes is 0.8333.
